uncited: It builds on [NeRF MLP Architecture](910-nerf-mlp-architecture.md) by expanding the capacity of the view-dependent color decoding stage.
*   MLP weights and biases for a 3-layer network with 256 hidden units.
Initialize the bottleneck vector $b$ with size 256.
Pass $b$ through a 3-layer Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) with 256 hidden units.
Apply a skip connection from the bottleneck vector $b$ to the second layer of the MLP.
